summary: TWR purpose: repair orchestration without weakening authority or auto-publishing Knowledge; W0 typed source selection, canonical identity, fail closed on omission/ambiguity/drift; W1 adapter owns deterministic paging, offsets, retries, rejects stale/conflicting continuation; W2 adapter proves hash/range coverage, model summaries non-authoritative; W3 separate execution/publication/review gates, allow verified degraded successor only when semantics unchanged, never auto-publish or start Bootstrap; W4 validator-owned immutable receipts in versioned generations, typed current pointer advances only after full validation; W5 attempts under .skill-input-work/<plan-id>/<attempt-id>, lifecycle plus lease/heartbeat, deterministic dry-run GC, apply needs maintainer approval for committed evidence and emits non-authorizing receipt; W6 non-authorizing end-to-end test covers all stages, protects valid current generation, blocks invalid pointer advancement; ownership: VDD=draft/plan-ready, Maintainer=implementation authorization, Quick Dev=implementation-complete, Acceptance=acceptance-passed; no new lifecycle authority
